items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-04-04
items.q: Well he made, we made eight, eight, you know four records in eight sides for him there, boy. And we ain't got that yet.

ctx.x: Yeah, you're used to that by now.
Well he made, we made eight, eight, you know four records in eight sides for him there, boy. And we ain't got that yet. And the records went over too. But he went on to California somewhere.

items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: Yeah, but that's the guy I said went away, and I never could get no royalties or nothing from him.

ctx.x: I'm trying to figure out which records you made, you know, and all that. Because I know you made some records for one of those companies. I think it was a Session company or something.
Session, yeah. That was downtown Chicago. Yeah, but that's the guy I said went away, and I never could get no royalties or nothing from him.
That must be Phil Feathering. Yeah, yeah. And those are the same ones with Richard M. Jones? Or was that...
